parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry the type name `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` — the `Mock` prefix is a canonical Swift test-fixture naming convention — and both files reside under test directories: `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift`. Although the pipeline has emitted `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false` for both records (likely a flag-extraction gap for test-support types that are not themselves `XCTestCase` subclasses), the file paths and type name constitute unambiguous literal evidence that these are test-fixture mock implementations. Consolidating them into a shared target would couple two independent test suites (`Metadata` and `app:iOS`) through a shared mock, which is an anti-pattern that makes test isolation harder to maintain. The duplication is intentional: each test file owns its own local mock to remain self-contained.
